title: Fraud Detection Project
summary: A machine learning fraud-detection system that trains classifiers on transaction data balanced with synthetic data from multiple GAN architectures (CTGAN, WGAN, SDGAN) and serves predictions via a Flask web app; SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is imported and fit on the fraud dataset to generate synthetic minority-class transactions.
evidence: colab notebooks/CTGAN(t2_500).ipynb:603 'ctgan = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=500, verbose=True)' then 'ctgan.fit(data_fraud)'
